name: Daniel Alvarez
headline: Software Developer
summary: Software Developer with a track record of building and refining customer-facing web products and internal workflows. Experienced in delivering features with JavaScript, TypeScript, GraphQL, Git and Redux, and in collaborating in Agile teams to keep releases predictable and stable.

roles.title: Software Developer
bullets: Built interactive user flows in JavaScript and TypeScript, wiring data from GraphQL services into the frontend state with Redux.
Used Git to keep changes organized across a 14-person product team and reduce merge conflicts during feature work.
Refined interfaces and bug fixes that improved release quality, cutting rework on the main product area by 22%.

roles.title: Software Developer
bullets: Delivered new product pages in Next.js, JavaScript and TypeScript, aligning implementation with Agile planning and weekly reviews.
Connected GraphQL data into Redux-based screens and tightened Git-based branch coordination across two parallel feature streams.
Improved frontend performance and launch readiness, supporting 18% faster page rendering for the most visited workflows.
Partnered with designers and backend colleagues to simplify complex journeys and ship clearer customer experiences.
